title: Communal monuments at Göbekli Tepe
summary: Communities in Upper Mesopotamia erected monumental structures with carved T-shaped pillars at Göbekli Tepe. The buildings belong to the Pre-Pottery Neolithic and are associated with hunter-gatherer societies.

claims.text: Communities in Upper Mesopotamia erected monumental structures with carved T-shaped pillars at Göbekli Tepe. The buildings belong to the Pre-Pottery Neolithic and are associated with hunter-gatherer societies.
Approximate archaeological phase; ritual uses are interpretations, not directly observed facts.

Monumental construction does not fit a single sequence in which farming, cities and temples always follow one another. The site offers evidence of collective work while the precise uses of individual structures remain interpretive.
